pa.s: 1 INTRODUCTION The objectives of this study are: • to evaluate the petroleum potential of eight samples from the Draupne Fm in well 15/12-21 by TOC and Rock-Eval analysis; • to determine which samples might be suitable for bulk kinetic analysis.
